From ba0cef2532717354d90ea81dc47837d61c98defc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Bart Van Assche <bvanassche@acm.org>
Date: Thu, 8 Aug 2019 20:01:26 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] scsi: qla2xxx: Include the <asm/unaligned.h> header file from
 qla_dsd.h

Since the put_unaligned_*() macros are used in this header file, include
the header file that defines these macros.

Cc: Himanshu Madhani <hmadhani@marvell.com>
Fixes: 15b7a68c1d03 ("scsi: qla2xxx: Introduce the dsd32 and dsd64 data structures") # v5.2-rc1.
Signed-off-by: Bart Van Assche <bvanassche@acm.org>
Tested-by: Himanshu Madhani <hmadhani@marvell.com>
Reviewed-by: Himanshu Madhani <hmadhani@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>

diff --git a/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_dsd.h b/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_dsd.h
index 7479924ba422..20788054b91b 100644
--- a/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_dsd.h
+++ b/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_dsd.h
@@ -1,6 +1,8 @@
 #ifndef _QLA_DSD_H_
 #define _QLA_DSD_H_
 
+#include <asm/unaligned.h>
+
 /* 32-bit data segment descriptor (8 bytes) */
 struct dsd32 {
 	__le32 address;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_dsd.h`**
   - Added the line `#include <asm/unaligned.h>` to include the header file that defines the `put_unaligned_*()` macros.

### Relationships

The modification in `qla_dsd.h` is directly related to the use of `put_unaligned_*()` macros within that file. By including `<asm/unaligned.h>`, the patch ensures that these macros are properly defined and available for use, addressing a potential issue that arose from the introduction of the `dsd32` and `dsd64` data structures in a previous commit (identified by the Fixes tag). This change is part of a bug fix aimed at improving the functionality and correctness of the SCSI driver for QLogic cards.
